name: Yugami Kairou
source:
There's been a string of murders in town, the corpses mutilated in horrifying ways... but there's no way anything's going to happen to *you*, right? Well, about that...

A collection of loosely-connected stories of encounters with otherworldly girls who may or may not be entirely sane.

[Translated and heavily edited from [url=http://pancake.kesagiri.net/yugami/story.htm]The Official website[/url]]
